title: Temporary Game Rate Decrease
source: kaggle CLI: competitions topic-messages pokemon-tcg-ai-battle 712893 -v --quiet -n -1 -s old

messages.content_html: Until https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/orbit-wars submission window closes (about 6 hours from now) we've decreased the game play rate in the competition to avoid so instability issues around the submission pipeline. Apologies for the inconveince and game rates should be back soon!
